arguments.summary: Captured the quotation process. Starts when a sales employee receives the customer's quotation request. The sales employee checks customer information in the CRM, then creates the quotation document in the quoting system using pricing information. If the quotation amount is over 1,000,000 yen, the manager approves the high-value quotation for credit risk management, then the quotation is sent to the customer via email. If the amount is at or below 1,000,000 yen, the quotation is sent directly. Separately, at the end of the month, the sales employee sends a month-end summary of quotation information to Accounting using Excel. Rationales for most steps were unknown to the stakeholder.
